name: chatbot
description: The AWS Chatbot API Reference provides descriptions, API request parameters, and the XML response for each of the AWS Chatbot API actions.

subcommands.name: associate-to-configuration
subcommands.description: Links a resource (for example, a custom action) to a channel configuration.

subcommands.name: create-chime-webhook-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates an AWS Chatbot configuration for Amazon Chime.

subcommands.name: create-custom-action
subcommands.description: Creates a custom action that can be invoked as an alias or as a button on a notification.

subcommands.name: create-microsoft-teams-channel-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates an AWS Chatbot configuration for Microsoft Teams.

subcommands.name: create-slack-channel-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates an AWS Chatbot confugration for Slack.

subcommands.name: delete-chime-webhook-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a Amazon Chime webhook configuration for AWS Chatbot.

subcommands.name: delete-custom-action
subcommands.description: Deletes a custom action.

subcommands.name: delete-microsoft-teams-channel-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a Microsoft Teams channel configuration for AWS Chatbot

subcommands.name: delete-microsoft-teams-configured-team
subcommands.description: Deletes the Microsoft Teams team authorization allowing for channels to be configured in that Microsoft Teams team.

subcommands.name: delete-microsoft-teams-user-identity
subcommands.description: Identifes a user level permission for a channel configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-slack-channel-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a Slack channel configuration for AWS Chatbot

subcommands.name: delete-slack-user-identity
subcommands.description: Deletes a user level permission for a Slack channel configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-slack-workspace-authorization
subcommands.description: Deletes the Slack workspace authorization that allows channels to be configured in that workspace.

subcommands.name: describe-chime-webhook-configurations
subcommands.description: Lists Amazon Chime webhook configurations optionally filtered by ChatConfigurationArn

subcommands.name: describe-slack-channel-configurations
subcommands.description: Lists Slack channel configurations optionally filtered by ChatConfigurationArn

subcommands.name: describe-slack-user-identities
subcommands.description: Lists all Slack user identities with a mapped role.

subcommands.name: describe-slack-workspaces
subcommands.description: List all authorized Slack workspaces connected to the AWS Account onboarded with AWS Chatbot.

subcommands.name: disassociate-from-configuration
subcommands.description: Unlink a resource, for example a custom action, from a channel configuration.

subcommands.name: get-account-preferences
subcommands.description: Returns AWS Chatbot account preferences.

subcommands.name: get-custom-action
subcommands.description: Returns a custom action.

subcommands.name: get-microsoft-teams-channel-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns a Microsoft Teams channel configuration in an AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-associations
subcommands.description: Lists resources associated with a channel configuration.

subcommands.name: list-custom-actions
subcommands.description: Lists custom actions defined in this account.

subcommands.name: list-microsoft-teams-channel-configurations
subcommands.description: Lists all AWS Chatbot Microsoft Teams channel configurations in an AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-microsoft-teams-configured-teams
subcommands.description: Lists all authorized Microsoft Teams for an AWS Account

subcommands.name: list-microsoft-teams-user-identities
subcommands.description: A list all Microsoft Teams user identities with a mapped role.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all of the tags associated with the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that you specify.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Attaches a key-value pair to a resource, as identified by its Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Detaches a key-value pair from a resource, as identified by its Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: update-account-preferences
subcommands.description: Updates AWS Chatbot account preferences.

subcommands.name: update-chime-webhook-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates a Amazon Chime webhook configuration.

subcommands.name: update-custom-action
subcommands.description: Updates a custom action.

subcommands.name: update-microsoft-teams-channel-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates an Microsoft Teams channel configuration.

subcommands.name: update-slack-channel-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates a Slack channel configuration.
